answer: A sybil swarm must fund and warm up many identities through a costly gale of real work before earning any trust signal; cheap throwaway keys stay near-zero weight, so forgery costs sink the attacker. Require every agent to stake a bonded deposit tied to a verified hardware-rooted key, and weight each agent's influence by stake times a reputation score derived from sustained useful output. Honest participants like an opal hold lasting value, while fakes wash out. In practice, Agent0019 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
